designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Driftless Area National Wildlife Refuge under the Endangered Species Act to protect the Iowa Pleistocene snail and its algific slopes.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Driftless Area National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Driftless Area National Wildlife Refuge: Comprehensive Conservation Plan and Environmental Impact Statement (ServCat 1415): "established in 1989 under the authority of the Endangered Species Act of 1973 with the purchase of 139.3 acres in Clayton County, Iowa"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Driftless Area National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1989 under the authority of the Endangered Species Act of 1973.
